verdict_semantics.PASS: every dimension at or above its minimum and no blocking items; the unit may proceed
verdict_semantics.FIX: a defect that can be fixed inside the current plan; the executor fixes and the reviewer writes cycle N+1
verdict_semantics.FAIL: a wrong premise — the plan or the brief cannot work as written; stop and report, do not iterate

plan-review.purpose: Before anyone implements: does the plan and contract cover the brief, and can the contract actually run?

brief_coverage.question: Does every acceptance criterion in brief.md map to at least one task and one contract check?

contract_runnable.question: Can every check in contract.yaml run from a clean checkout with no hidden setup, and does it fail when the criterion is not met?

handoff_complete.question: Does the Hand-off section name planner, executor, reviewer, budget and a stop condition an executor can act on?

scope.question: Is out-of-scope explicit, and is nothing in plan.md outside brief.md?

evidence.rule: each item cites a file path, with a heading or line, that the reviewer read

code-review.purpose: After implementation: is the code correct, does it match the plan, are the tests real, and does the spec still describe it?
code-review.reviews: the diff since contract.yaml base, features/<id>/DONE.json and the evidence logs it names

correctness.question: Does the code do what the brief's acceptance criteria say, including the failure paths?

matches_plan.question: Does the diff follow plan.md, with any departure written down in plan.md or tasks.md?

tests_real.question: Did the contract's test/e2e checks actually run (evidence logs present, exit codes recorded), and would they fail if the feature were broken?

spec_current.question: Does brief.md still describe the shipped surface — routes, controls, behaviours — after this change?

evidence.rule: each item cites a file path or a command the reviewer ran, never a paraphrase of the executor's summary

spec-review.purpose: After a follow-up change: does the spec still tell the truth about the code?
spec-review.reviews: features/<id>/brief.md and contract.yaml against the code at HEAD

describes_surface.question: Is every route and UI control the code exposes named in brief.md?

no_stale_statements.question: Is there no sentence in brief.md that the code now contradicts?

contract_current.question: Does contract.yaml still check the behaviour the brief promises, including what the follow-up added?

evidence.rule: each item cites a brief.md line and the code location it was checked against
